anna: Quick announce  Private Deploy 3.1 GA planned for 2026-08-03. Focus: Audit Escrow + Customer-Controlled Export Keys (BYOXK). Goal is to give regulated customers stronger guarantees over audit bundles and retention without sending raw keys offsite. High-level:
- Audit Escrow: customers can designate an escrow endpoint (third-party auditor or customer vault) where signed, encrypted audit bundles are pushed on export. Bundles are encrypted with a per-tenant export key.
- BYOXK (Bring Your Own eXport Key): customers may provide an export-wrapping key (PKCS#11 / PEM) so only they or their auditor can unwrap exported bundles. Redwood stores only the wrapped key.
- Retention Policy Controls: tenant-level retention windows for audit artifacts (configurable 30d/90d/365d). Exports can be auto-purged or archived to customer object stores.
- Proof-of-Export: each bundle includes a compact Merkle-root proof and a signed timestamp token so customers can verify integrity without exposing content.

Quick notes for teams:
- No forced churn. Existing export behavior remains until customers opt in.
- New tenants default to export_push=off; enterprise/regulated tenants can enable during onboarding.

Customer-facing UX:
- Console: new Audit Export page to configure escrow endpoint, upload/export key, and set retention. Approve flow shows a short security checklist.
- Exports: customers who provide BYOXK will receive bundles encrypted with their key. For auditors, we can register auditor public keys and push directly.

CLI snippets for reference:
```
# register an escrow endpoint and upload wrapped export key
rwctl audit escrow-register --tenant TID --endpoint https://escrow.cust-auditor.com --upload-wrapped-key wrapped-key.bin
# create an immediate export to tenant's S3 and escrow
rwctl audit export-now --tenant TID --out s3://bucket/export.tar.gz --escrow yes
```

Action items (internal):
- SEs: flag regulated customers (lia) and offer early access for validation.
- Security: review BYOXK wrapping lifecycle and KMS usage (sec-bot).
- Docs: guide for escrow config, auditor onboarding, and verification steps (kevin).
- Ops: prepare canary + delivery webhook runner (ops-bot).

Timeline:
- 2026-07-28: internal canary + partner audit validation
- 2026-08-03: GA opt-in opens to all enterprise customers
- 2026-09-03: evaluation of opt-in uptake; legacy exports remain for opt-out customers unless contract modified
